wireDerivation.reason: The 0.19.0 agent showed the failed turn's reason verbatim as the -32603 message (src/acp/agent.ts at 0.19.0: `event.reason ?? event.errorKind ?? event.terminal`), so the CLI's `turn/completed` carried this text as `reason`; the m91 capture shows `reason` mirrors `error.message`. Tests use the message above byte for byte in both members.
wireDerivation.quota: The CLI's typed quota detail (TurnError.quota: QuotaDetail{limitKind, resetsAtMs}, ADR 50047 D2/D3, verified in CLI 1.4.10's offline export via `muse schema generate-json-schema --out <dir>` on 2026-10-31): present iff the stopping failure was the quota class. Tests carry limitKind `tierLimit` with the observed reset instant above.
wireDerivation.kind: `modelError`: the recorded model-failure kind (docs/certification/m91-captures/05-linux-msp-failure/turn-completed.jsonl, 2026-10-04). The product never branches on it; it rides along as the typed kind.
wireDerivation.retryable: Not known from this observation. The CLI's judgment for a quota failure is unrecorded, so tests cover both `true` and `false`: the quota outcome is identical either way, and neither resends before the reset.
wireDerivation.sessionRecord: The same TurnError is restated as `LastTurn.error` on `session/resume` and `session/read` (CLI 1.4.10 schema export, ADR 36635 D2/D3). No surface re-announces a resumed session's last turn, so the product reads the live `turn/completed` only; the record shape is noted here, not parsed.
